rationale: Step 9 (bivariate employment-personal-income system, Figure 13/C23) produced results/bivariate_irfs.json with emp_income.irf giving the per-capita personal income response to a -1% employment shock over years 0-20. The path is normalized to a -1% employment shock (emp yr0 = -1.000%). The pcincome response reaches its trough of -0.835% at year 1 and is -0.812% at year 2 (irf['2'].pcincome = -0.008121758), then returns slowly toward zero over the 20-year horizon (yr5 -0.564%, yr10 -0.314%, yr20 -0.106%). This qualitatively confirms the paper's description ('decreases by 0.9 percent after two years and returns slowly to zero'): the shape (trough near year 1-2, slow return to zero) matches exactly. The magnitude at year 2, -0.81%, differs from the paper's -0.9% by ~9.8% relative error — outside the 5% match band but well within the 30% partial band. No relevant critical fix was flagged in fix_severity.json for this code path. Hence a partial match.
